meta.note: Single source of truth for code. Mirror of the Figma variables. Three tiers: _primitives -> _config -> color (semantic). Figma path separator '/' becomes '-' in token names. tokens.css is GENERATED from this file by build-tokens.js: never edit it by hand.

tokens.name: black
tokens.usage: Primitive. Never bind directly; alias through semantic tokens.

tokens.name: white-0
tokens.usage: Primitive. White at 0% alpha. Figma name as-is — inconsistent with black-a*; expected white-a0.

tokens.name: white-4
tokens.usage: Primitive. White at 4% alpha. Figma name as-is; expected white-a4.

tokens.name: white-8
tokens.usage: Primitive. White at 8% alpha. Figma name as-is; expected white-a8.

tokens.name: white-16
tokens.usage: Primitive. White at 16% alpha. Figma name as-is; expected white-a16.

tokens.name: white-24
tokens.usage: Primitive. White at 24% alpha. Figma name as-is; expected white-a24.

tokens.name: acid-green
tokens.usage: Primitive. Brand hue. Not for text on light grounds (1.3:1 on white).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Config. The one brand decision: change this and every accent use follows.

tokens.name: surface-support-1
tokens.usage: Tag background. Text on it: text-strong (~13:1).

tokens.name: text-strong
tokens.usage: Default text on surface-base and light grounds.

tokens.name: text-accent
tokens.usage: Accent text. Only on dark grounds: never on surface-base.

tokens.name: action-primary-border-default
tokens.usage: Button primary, border, default. Transparent by design.

tokens.name: action-floating-foreground-default
tokens.usage: Semantic. Icon + label of chromeless controls (PlayerButton). Figma: action/floating/foreground/default.

tokens.name: action-floating-foreground-hover
tokens.usage: Semantic. Icon + label of chromeless controls (PlayerButton). Figma: action/floating/foreground/hover.

tokens.name: action-floating-foreground-pressed
tokens.usage: Semantic. Icon + label of chromeless controls (PlayerButton). Figma: action/floating/foreground/pressed.

tokens.name: action-floating-foreground-disabled
tokens.usage: Semantic. Icon + label of chromeless controls (PlayerButton). Figma: action/floating/foreground/disabled.

tokens.name: action-floating-background-default
tokens.usage: Semantic. Background of chromeless controls (PlayerButton): only hover/pressed show a tint. Figma: action/floating/background/default.

tokens.name: action-floating-background-hover
tokens.usage: Semantic. Background of chromeless controls (PlayerButton): only hover/pressed show a tint. Figma: action/floating/background/hover.

tokens.name: action-floating-background-pressed
tokens.usage: Semantic. Background of chromeless controls (PlayerButton): only hover/pressed show a tint. Figma: action/floating/background/pressed.

tokens.name: action-floating-background-disabled
tokens.usage: Semantic. Background of chromeless controls (PlayerButton): only hover/pressed show a tint. Figma: action/floating/background/disabled.

tokens.name: border-divider-strong
tokens.usage: Dividers. Figma variable is named 'border divider/strong' (space): mapped to border-divider-strong; rename in Figma to border/divider/strong.

tokens.name: tab-background-hover
tokens.usage: Tab, background, hover. Transparent — the hover state is the dashed border (8/8).

tokens.name: tab-background-pressed
tokens.usage: Tab, background, pressed. Transparent — the pressed state is the dashed border (4/4).

spacing.note: Mirror of the Figma collection `dimension`. Component paddings are still hardcoded in Figma, so only page margins exist here.

tokens.name: page-margin-desktop
tokens.usage: Horizontal page padding on desktop (Figma: page-margin/desktop). The header and page content sit inside it.

tokens.name: page-margin-mobile
tokens.usage: Horizontal page padding on mobile (Figma: page-margin/mobile).

tokens.name: small
tokens.usage: Figma: `small` (no namespace - expected space/small). Breadcrumbs padding.

tokens.name: gutter-small
tokens.usage: Figma: gutter/small. Not used by a component yet.

tokens.name: medium-small
tokens.usage: Figma: `medium-small` (no namespace - expected space/medium-small). Not used by a component yet.

breakpoint.note: NOT in Figma: Figma frames are fill/auto layout, mobile drawn at 375 (smallest common device). The single place the desktop/mobile switch is decided. Not emitted as a CSS variable (custom properties do not work in @media): CSS sources write `@media (--mobile)` and media.js expands it at build time.

tokens.name: mobile
tokens.usage: Viewport below 768px uses the mobile variants. Placeholder value to confirm.

styles.name: label-micro
styles.usage: Uppercase. Mirrors Figma text style label/micro.
